title: Pre-registered proxy gates for the SIMULATED historical BUY robustness study
authority: Frozen BEFORE study results were computed. Any gate change requires a new study_id and a fresh run; results under an edited contract are void.
purpose: Mathematical robustness check of the BUY logic shape (undervalued + tape event + quality screen) over the available 3-year price cache. It is NOT the clean sealed track record, which starts 2026-07 and lives in buy_set_snapshots kind='sealed'.

rebalance.date_rule: first trading day of each calendar month present in the price cache
rebalance.entry_rule: first close strictly after the rebalance date (same convention as buy_performance_book.forward_return)

gates.name: Sealed MoS > 0
gates.rule: vector.mos_live > 0 (fair band sealed at panel date_l)
gates.disclosure: LOOK-AHEAD: the fair band was estimated at date_l using fundamentals that were not available at earlier simulation dates.

gates.name: Gap to median at simulation date > 0
gates.rule: (fair_px_med - close_at_sim_date) / close_at_sim_date > 0, close from PIT bars <= sim date
gates.disclosure: Price side is PIT; the fair_px_med side inherits the G1 look-ahead.

gates.name: Tape event (PIT)
gates.rule: >=25% peak-to-trough drawdown in the trailing ~18 months of bars dated <= sim date; >=40 bars required, else the ticker is excluded (fail closed)

gates.name: Completeness proxy
gates.rule: vector.completeness grade in {A, B} and kill_active is false (known)
gates.disclosure: NON-PIT: uses the current sealed vector's grade and kill state; historical grades and kill reviews do not exist before 2026-07.

inference.portfolio: equal-weight across gate-passing tickers per rebalance date
inference.benchmark: SPY (FMP close, unadjusted — no adjClose from source; dividend drag understates SPY, flattering excess returns slightly)
statistics: max drawdown of monthly book series
Newey-West t-stat on monthly excess returns (Bartlett kernel, lags = overlap-aware)

disclosures: SIMULATED — this is a robustness study, not a track record. The clean sealed ledger starts 2026-07.
Fair bands are single-snapshot (date_l); every valuation gate is look-ahead-contaminated by construction.
Completeness grades and kill states are today's, applied backwards (survivorship of review effort, not of listing).
Universe membership is today's sealed universe applied backwards (membership look-ahead).
SPY benchmark is price-only (no dividends), which slightly overstates excess returns.
Price cache spans ~3 years only; no full-cycle evidence.
Simulated snapshots are stored with kind='simulated' and are never served by the sealed BUY performance book API.
